verdict.rationale: All three distribution channels in the story are documented. Teams can commit skills to `.agents/skills`, which Codex scans up to the repo root (docs-9, docs-17). A shared marketplace source can be added with `codex plugin marketplace add`, and plugins are installed from configured marketplaces via `/plugins` (docs-11, docs-25, docs-35). Curated skills can also be installed with `$skill-installer` (docs-8). A community user also cites cross-team standardization as a core use of skills (comm-4). Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of a team-wide private marketplace rollout, and evidence of admin-enforced or org-level distribution beyond each member adding the source.
